subject: VPC/on-prem pricing and support bands — Castor Health
messages:
From: Katie Jensen <katie@castorhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial ask — VPC/on-prem pricing, platform fee and support tiers

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo earlier — Castor Health loved the performance profile for the private deployment. Our procurement team asked me to gather the following so we can run an internal TCO comparison: 

- A clear breakdown of the one-time onboarding/installation costs vs recurring platform fee.
- Support tiers (Standard, Premier) and the response/oncall commitments per tier.
- Multi-year pricing and any staged discounts for 2- or 3-year commits.
- Any available migration/onboarding credits or professional services hours bundling.

Can you send a short commercial outline we can attach to our vendor evaluation? Also: our security lead will follow up with SOC2 evidence — we may loop in legal later.

Best,
Katie
Director of Infrastructure
Castor Health

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Jensen <katie@castorhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-12T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — VPC/on-prem pricing, platform fee and support tiers

Hi Katie — great to meet you today. Attaching a short commercial outline and the pricing bands workbook for clarity (see attachments). High-level options below — happy to hop on a short call to walk through: 

1) Entry VPC (Metered) — minimal platform fee
   - Platform fee: $5k/month
   - Usage: per-inference token and per-embedding unit (attached SKU breakout)
   - Support: Standard (business hours, 24hr ticket SLA)
   - Good for proof-of-concept or low predictable volume

2) Committed Dedicated (Reserved capacity) — best unit economics
   - Platform fee: $18k/month (includes baseline operational SLA)
   - Committed GPU pool (example: 4 A100-equivalent nodes) priced in the workbook
   - Support: Premier by default (24x7 P1, named TAM, monthly business review)
   - Discounts: 10% off list for 12-month commit; 18% off for 36-month commit

3) On‑prem (air‑gapped) licensing
   - One-time licensing fee + annual platform fee (starts at $120k/year)
   - Optional on-site install (PS hours) or remote install (included 40 hours)
   - Support: Premier or Enterprise (SLA and on-call included)

Migration credits: For 36-month committed deals we typically provide a mix of onboarding credits (40–120 PS hours) and one-time invoice credit to offset the platform fee in Q1. 

Next steps I propose: I’ll draft a short SOW and commercial term sheet and loop Legal for a standard enterprise addendum. Ben and Laura — can you review the 36-month concession band (attachment) and confirm if we can offer an additional $15k onboarding credit for Castor?

- Rachel

Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2025-06-13T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — VPC/on-prem pricing, platform fee and support tiers

Rachel — quick internal. I ran the numbers on DEAL-8721 (Castor). Thoughts:

- 36-month commit with 18% discount is reasonable, but Castor flagged migration effort (they're migrating from self-hosted LLM infra). Offering 80–100 PS hours is typical; $15k onboarding credit is within region.
- Approve $15k onboarding credit if we secure a signed 36-month commit and a 12-month minimum invoice guarantee.
- For on-prem license option, ask Legal to add a limited liability carveout around HSM/KMS integration.

Laura — can you confirm PS staffing (remote install + 2 onsite days) and the runbook deliverables that map to the 80–100 hours? Vivek — anything from finance on how we should amortize the onboarding credit?

- Ben
